parts.content: Work in D:\PropelExp. Implement EP-002 US_019 TASK_001 through TASK_003 completely. Read all three task files first and follow existing backend Pydantic patterns and the US_017/US_018 candidate contracts already present. Required files: backend/src/cms_planner/application/ports/extraction_response.schema.json, backend/src/cms_planner/adapters/ai/extraction_response_validator.py, backend/src/cms_planner/modules/extraction/schema_failure.py, backend/tests/contract/test_extraction_response_contract.py, backend/tests/integration/extraction/test_schema_storage_gate.py. Also add the task_002 focused unit test path if needed by its Build Commands. Requirements: one closed aggregate response requiring provider, deficiency, evidence, confidence, uncertainty fields with no unknowns; missing/unknown/out-of-range/artifact-only normalized text rejects the entire response; never clamp confidence; valid candidates are unconfirmed; invalid response yields one safe typed failure and zero writes; atomic all-or-nothing storage behavior. Use standard library and Pydantic only unless an existing dependency supports this; schema itself must be JSON Schema 2020-12. Avoid duplicating candidate rules where existing domain models can enforce them. TDD with immediate focused validation after first edit. Keep complexity <=7. Mark all validation/checklist boxes [x] in these three task files only after focused suites pass. Run all task build-command suites together and return changed files/tests. Do not touch frontend or unrelated files.
